_comment: MAE reads inverted from ORFE. MAE puts the talk title in the ICS SUMMARY and the speaker on the event page; ORFE does the reverse. So SUMMARY maps to title here (not speaker), comma re-escaping is off because that convention suits a speaker name and not a title, and the location strategy reads 'Bowen Hall 222' rather than ORFE's '125 - Sherrerd Hall'. The speaker is filled by enrichment -- see ENRICH_TARGET_FIELD and ENRICH_SUBTITLE_SELECTOR.
